description: This file contains unit tests for UI script behavior related to Windows command shell usage and argument safety, utilizing the vitest testing framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for UI Windows spawn behavior.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Sets up expectations for test assertions.

methods.name: shouldUseShellForCommand
methods.description: Determines whether to invoke command using a shell based on the command path and platform.

methods.name: assertSafeWindowsShellArgs
methods.description: Validates that Windows shell arguments are safe to prevent command injection vulnerabilities.
